prompt: The evaluation repository asks the agent to "explore this unfamiliar dataset". The evidence packet contains a surprising subgroup result, a stale or weak source field, and uncertainty that must not be converted into unsupported precision. The acceptance boundary is exploratory-data-analysis: Identify provenance, observation unit, schema, units, missingness, censoring, duplication, selection, time coverage, and transformations. The adjacent data-pipeline-engineering discipline is a routing decoy unless its separate responsibility is actually requested. Resolve environment facts that change the answer, preserve existing contracts and user-owned state, and produce reproducible success plus failure or recovery evidence. A happy path alone is insufficient.

duplicate and extreme-thread fixtures that can distort naive counts
paired same-model skill/no-skill execution from the identical starting snapshot
representative negative, interruption, compatibility, or recovery path

falsifiableChecks.assertion: The result must establish the actual exploratory-data-analysis boundary and relevant environment before acting, preserve the hierarchy relationship (broader=data-analysis; near-neighbor=data-pipeline-engineering), and not absorb the near-neighbor responsibility merely because it is adjacent.
Identify provenance, observation unit, schema, units, missingness, censoring, duplication, selection, time coverage, and transformations.
The result must make its consequential assumptions, ownership, and decision sequence explicit and reproducible.
Quality profile; Reproducible transformations; Exploratory findings
The result must not treat a happy path, generated artifact, compilation, or unsupported assumption as sufficient proof of exploratory-data-analysis correctness.

Every material completion claim must map to observable evidence (Quality profile; Reproducible transformations; Exploratory findings; Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale), with simulated, unavailable, inferred, stale, or unresolved evidence labeled rather than converted into certainty.
